name: whm-mcp
description: Administer a cPanel & WHM server through the WHM API: accounts, domains, DNS, email, packages, SSL, backups, resellers, security, PHP, and logs. Starts read-only; turning on changes is a setting.

whm_host.title: WHM host
whm_host.description: Hostname of the WHM server, e.g. srv.example.com. Use the name on WHM's SSL certificate.

whm_token.title: WHM API token
whm_token.description: Create one in WHM under Development > Manage API Tokens. Its privileges limit what this plugin can do.

whm_user.title: WHM user
whm_user.description: The WHM user the token belongs to: root, or a reseller.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: On: only tools that read are available. Off: Claude can also change the server (delete accounts, edit DNS, restart services, reboot), each with a confirmation.

toolsets.title: Toolsets
toolsets.description: 'all', or a comma-separated subset to keep the tool list short: accounts, domains, server, dns, email, packages, ssl, backups, resellers, security, software, logs, api.

insecure_tls.title: Skip TLS verification
insecure_tls.description: Only for a server you trust that has a self-signed certificate.
